name: What do I need to do first to generate a Knowledge Graph and Entity File for my business?

mainEntity.name: What do I need to do first to generate a Knowledge Graph and Entity File for my business?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need to start by defining the specific business problem you want to solve, then identify your data sources (structured or unstructured), and finally establish a schema or ontology to define entities and relationships before generating the graph.
acceptedAnswer.description: Define your business problem, identify data sources, and create a schema or ontology to map entities and relationships before starting generation.
